item.text:
**Bottom Line**  
`5B.5` is **mixed, leaning negative**. Tinubu made several public anti-corruption and transparency claims and pushed some technocratic reforms, but the strongest concrete appointment evidence includes a son-in-law heading a federal housing agency, and there are serious opacity / anti-scrutiny signals around public spending and the Cybercrimes Act.

**Evidence For**
- **With Good Governance and Commitment, We must Overcome Old Subsidy Beneficiaries** | State House | 2024-03-15 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/with-good-governance-and-commitment-we-must-overcomee-old-subsidy-benificiaries-president-tinubu/) | Tinubu said the treasury must not be abused, framed subsidy reform as a way to fund student loans and consumer credit, and tied relief to NIN-based targeting. That is direct anti-rent-seeking rhetoric and a pro-broad-base distribution signal. | `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.4`
- **President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement** | State House | 2024-06-15 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/) | Reorganizing procurement is a concrete anti-corruption / anti-favoritism move because it targets a major rent channel and aims to improve transparency and value for money. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`
- **President Tinubu: Live Up To Your Expectation As Public Trust For Accountability** | State House | 2024-07-06 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-live-up-to-your-expectation-as-public-trust-for-accountability/) | Tinubu said public institutions are not personal enterprises and urged merit, accountability, and the exploitation of no loopholes. This is strong anti-capture rhetoric, though still aspirational. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`
- **President Tinubu Urges ECOWAS Countries To Ratify, Fully Implement Anti-corruption Protocol** | State House | 2024-08-19 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-urges-ecowas-countries-to-ratify-fully-implement-anti-corruption-protocol/) | Tinubu publicly called for stronger anti-corruption institutions and implementation of the ECOWAS anti-corruption protocol, showing at least formal commitment to anti-graft norms. | `5B.5`
- **Nigeria: 2024 Article IV Consultation - Press Release, Staff Report, Staff Statement, and Statement by the Executive Director for Nigeria** | IMF | 2024-05-09 | [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/05/08/nigeria-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-staff-statement-and-548726) | IMF credited the administration with subsidy removal, FX unification, and governance measures. These are relevant because they cut into some privileged rents and reduce opportunities for politically protected arbitrage. | `5B.5`, `5B.3`, `5B.4`
- **Supporting Nigeria’s Homegrown Reforms: New World Bank Financing for Inclusive Growth and Revenue Diversification** | World Bank | 2024-06-13 | [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/13/supporting-nigeria-homegrown-reforms-new-world-bank-financing-for-inclusive-growth-and-revenue-diversification) | The Bank said the reforms aimed to raise non-oil revenue, safeguard oil revenue, and create fiscal space, which is consistent with reducing rent extraction and redirecting resources toward public goods. | `5B.5`, `5B.3`, `5B.4`
- **President Tinubu says he has no cabal or sponsors to compensate** | State House | 2024-07-26 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/) | Tinubu explicitly denied owing a cabal or sponsors, which is not proof, but it is direct rebuttal to a loyalty-repayment narrative. | `5B.5`, `5B.2`

**Evidence Against**
- **Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency** | BusinessDay | 2024-02-21 | [URL](https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/) | The appointment of Tinubu’s son-in-law to the Federal Housing Authority is the clearest concrete nepotism signal in the 2024 record, directly cutting against resistance to favoritism and politically connected privilege. | `5B.5`, `5B.2`
- **Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency** | BusinessDay | 2024-02-21 | [URL](https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/) | Critics said the move looked like entrenched corruption and favoritism rather than merit-based stewardship, which weakens the anti-capture claim. | `5B.5`, `5B.2`
- **FG spent N63.6bn on military equipment in seven months - Report** | Punch | 2024-08-17 | [URL](https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n63-6bn-on-military-equipment-in-seven-months-report/) | Large, weakly disclosed military-equipment spending raises transparency and diversion concerns. It does not prove graft, but it is negative evidence for clean procurement and resistance to privileged spending channels. | `5B.5`, `5B.3`, `5B.4`
- **Nigeria’s Tinubu names seven ministers, sacks five in cabinet reshuffle** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-23 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-sacks-five-in-cabinet-reshuffle/2325625/) | The reshuffle appears more like ordinary executive housekeeping than a purge of patronage networks, so it is only weak counterevidence. It does not show a strong anti-oligarchic break. | `5B.5`, `5B.2`
- **Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown** | Reuters via GPB | 2024-05-09 | [URL](https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown) | Detaining a journalist over corruption reporting suggests an environment where scrutiny of elites is punished, which weakens resistance to corruption. | `5B.5`, `5B.6`, `5B.4`
- **Four Nigerian journalists charged with cybercrime / defamation over fraud investigation** | CPJ | 2024-02-09 | [URL](https://cpj.org/2024/02/4-nigerian-journalists-charged-with-cybercrime-defamation-over-fraud-investigation/) | Criminal charges for reporting on corruption are negative evidence for anti-capture governance because they chill oversight of connected actors. | `5B.5`, `5B.6`, `5B.4`
- **Freedom House Freedom on the Net 2024: Nigeria** | Freedom House | 2024 | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House reported cybercrime-law pressure, monitoring of “false information,” and blocking powers that can be used to suppress scrutiny. That does not prove corruption, but it is a bad sign for accountability. | `5B.5`, `5B.6`, `5B.4`
- **President Tinubu: I have no Cabal or Sponsors to Compensate** | State House | 2024-07-26 | [URL](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/) | This is anti-capture rhetoric, but it also implicitly confirms that accusations of sponsors/cabal politics were salient enough to require rebuttal. Rhetoric alone is weak against the concrete nepotism evidence above. | `5B.5`, `5B.2`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong direct evidence of a major anti-monopoly campaign, cartel breakup, or explicit rollback of politically connected business privileges in 2024.
- The cleanest positive items are reform rhetoric, procurement reform, subsidy/FX changes, and technocratic framing.
- The cleanest negative items are the son-in-law appointment and the broader pattern of opacity / press pressure around oversight of power and money.
